pr_title: Fix: avoid embedding the user input into the error response.
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## What does this PR do?
Fix #2107. 

The problem is meilisearch embeds the user input to the error message. 

The reason for this problem is `milli` throws a `serde_json: Error` whose `Display` implementation will do this embedding.  

I tried to solve this problem in this PR by manually implementing the `Display` trait for `DocumentFormatError` instead of deriving automatically.

issue_context.title: Error message contains whole payload when the type is not correct
issue_context.body: **Describe the bug** I tried to send (wrongly) a string using `POST /indexes/x/documents`. The returned error message from MeiliSearch is as follows: `MeiliSearchApiError: The json payload provided is malformed. "whole payload"`. In my case the `whole payload` is 3million character long. So my error message looks like this: (ignore the popup from vscode) **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Add a string instead of a document with content-type json 2. It throws an error containing the whole string **Expected behavior** Maybe a more explicit error `The json payload provided is malformed, expected an array but go a string instead` **Screenshots** see above **MeiliSearch version:** v0.25.1
comments: do you you have a minimum reproducible example so I can see what triggers this error? @bidoubiwa

Could you try by adding the following as the body of `POST /documents` 

```
""\{ "\id"\: 1 }"\"
```

As you can see it is a json inside a string inside a string. That was my mistake. The error should be 
```
MeiliSearchApiError: The json payload provided is malformed. "whole payload". ""\{ "\id"\: 1 }"\"
```

In my use case, the string is 3 million chars long. So the error is a bit longer 😂

Not sure this is a bug. I thought maybe it could be capped at a certain size.
Thanks @bidoubiwa for the report :) Will check with the @meilisearch/product-team and core team what to do

Tried the test case above on master and didn't reproduce the issue, if im wrong in inserting and the issue is still correct for now,would like to commit PR 
after some guidelines, thank you!

Hello @ilyatrefilov sorry for the delay, yes the issue is still present!
Look at this simpler example:
```bash
% curl http://localhost:7700/indexes/mieli/documents -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '"Hello @ilyatrefilov"'
```
Which returns:
```json
{
  "message": "The `json` payload provided is malformed. `Couldn't serialize document value: invalid type: string \"Hello @ilyatrefilov\", expected a documents, or a sequence of documents. at line 1 column 21`.",
  "code": "malformed_payload",
  "type": "invalid_request",
  "link": "https://docs.meilisearch.com/errors#malformed_payload"
}
```
